lines: COLLIDE 1415 parts, 264 moving in 10 layers; the 32 loop frames
COLLIDE fixed: 0 clashes (reaching more than 0.03 tile into each other, no rule explains them), 1151 fixed parts, 2035 touching pairs (collide.txt)

ignored: remnants (remnants: the corpse's wreck, not drawn with the building)
status-lamp (a white cut the engine tints: not drawn here)

footprint_rows_tiles: bottom edge below origin; 2.5 = on the footprint
remnants_shadow_px: pixels of shadow baked into the wreck (part transparent, every channel at most 8) and their share of its area; under 64 px or 0.01 fails (no catcher); vanilla's remnants 0.24-0.52
remnants_edge_px: pixels of the wreck or its shadow on its canvas's edge; 0 = the canvas holds it
remnants_reach_tiles: how far past each footprint edge, as it stands in this direction, the debris (alpha over 128, not near black) and everything kept (the shadow too) reach, tiles; below 0 short of it. Vanilla's turbine: debris -0.45 to -0.03, all 0.11 to 0.64
carousel_cycle: frames of a closed loop; no positional check
drive_cycle: frames of a closed loop; no positional check
lid_cycle: frames of a closed loop; no positional check
crane_cycle: frames of a closed loop; no positional check
commutator_drift_px: centroid travel across the 32 frames; ~0 = turning in place, must stay within 1
coupling-converter_drift_px: centroid travel across the 32 frames; ~0 = turning in place, must stay within 1
coupling-pump_cycle: frames of a closed loop; no positional check
gauge-switchgear_cycle: frames of a closed loop; no positional check
gauge-converter_cycle: frames of a closed loop; no positional check
gauge-transformer_cycle: frames of a closed loop; no positional check
window-glow_white_px: the most pixels of the light, in any frame, clipped to white; 0 = it keeps its colour
window-glow_clipped_px: the most pixels, in any frame, the light drives to white added over 'window' on the plate; 0 = nothing clips
window-glow_frames: its frames and its plate layer 'window''s: equal
window-glow_edge_px: the most pixels, in any frame, of the light (bloom and all, above GLOW_FLOOR 2) on the canvas's edge; 0 = the tail fades out inside it
window-glow_light: frame 0: peak luminance, core % (>= 60 % of the peak), halo % (<= 25 %); vanilla's glows: peak 87-171, core 2-8, halo 77-88
frame0_vs_still: max channel difference, and share of pixels over 8 (sampling noise)
rolloff_px: per sheet but a shadow's or a light's, the px the highlight roll-off changed (brightest channel over 236, eased under 244, hue kept) and the most a channel moved; render.json's rolloff false opts out
